R313.note: Replaces the f-string with a ? placeholder bound via sqlite3's execute() tuple; query semantics and response shape unchanged.

R314.note: %s parameterisation plus repr() neutralises CR/LF and other control characters; the resulting quoted log form is stated plainly and blocks nothing.

R315.note: Adds secure: true to the res.cookie() options and nothing else; httpOnly and maxAge preserved.

R316.note: Session-bound HMAC synchronizer token in a custom header closes CSRF, but the handler quietly reorders the checks so a session-less cross-origin request now gets 401 instead of the original 403, and the unconfigured per-process key fallback would reject legitimate users across multiple instances.

R317.note: Wraps both interpolated values in $cgi->escapeHTML() at the same print; undef handling and output structure match the original.

R318.note: GUID-generated name with fixed .cshtml extension removes client control of the path and extension, but the admin-chosen template name is lost (the partial can no longer be referenced or updated by name, and re-upload no longer replaces), only partly disclosed via the changed stored field.

R319.note: Single unsigned >= MAX_PLAYERS check before the array write; in-range updates unchanged and out-of-range packets are dropped where the original had undefined behaviour.

R320.note: Interceptor shape and status codes are right, but the role is read from client-supplied x-user-role metadata, so any caller that can reach :50051 still deletes projects by sending x-user-role: admin; the write-up admits the identity source is a placeholder resting on an assumed upstream gateway.

R321.note: JavaScriptEncoder.Default.Encode escapes quotes, backslashes, angle brackets and U+2028/9 for the JS string-literal context; the decoded runtime value trackSearch receives is unchanged and the new package dependency is stated.

R322.note: Range check against calibrationTable.size() before operator[], reusing the function's existing return-rawReading convention for rejected input.

R323.note: prepare()/bindValue() with a named placeholder closes the injection, but the original's $stmt === false guard (return null -> 404 on query failure) was dropped without mention, so under PDO silent/warning error mode a failed prepare now becomes a fatal method-call-on-bool instead of a 404.

R324.note: Separator-qualified prefix check on the cleaned Join result runs before both MkdirAll calls and os.Create, aborting with an error on escaping entries; legitimate entries and the symlink caveat are handled/stated.
